request.source:
-- 临时显示影子断点以读取删除标记，随后恢复显示设置；不改动断点或运行状态。
local list = nil
for index=0,getFormCount()-1 do
    local form=getForm(index)
    if form.ClassName=='TfrmBreakpointlist' then list=form end
end
assert(list~=nil,'Breakpoint list unavailable')
local shadow=list.findComponentByName('miShowShadow')
local timer=list.findComponentByName('Timer1')
local previous=shadow.Checked
local completed,result=pcall(function()
    shadow.Checked=true
    timer.OnTimer(timer)
    local view=list.findComponentByName('ListView1')
    local rows={}
    for index=0,view.Items.Count-1 do
        local item=view.Items[index]
        rows[#rows+1]={caption=item.Caption,subitems=item.SubItems.Text}
    end
    return {rows=rows}
end)
shadow.Checked=previous
timer.OnTimer(timer)
assert(completed,tostring(result))
return result
